levels.title: Java Basics
levels.summary: Coder Army Java Full Course, lectures 1-21: syntax, number storage, operators, control flow, arrays, functions and the complete OOP core.
levels.whyItMatters: Every Spring annotation and every JPA entity is just Java. Finishing these 21 lectures properly is what makes Spring Boot feel logical instead of magical.
levels.projectDescription: A command-line task manager: add/list/complete/delete tasks, save them to a file. Learn loops, file I/O, collections and basic object design without worrying about web layers.

topics.title: Introduction to Java
topics.description: What Java is, where it is used (backend, Android, big data), why it is platform independent and how this course is structured.
topics.practice: Install JDK 21 and an IDE (IntelliJ IDEA Community) and confirm `java -version` works.

topics.title: First Java program, JVM vs JDK vs JRE
topics.description: Writing and running Hello World; compile (javac) vs run (java); bytecode; what the JVM, JRE and JDK each do; Java SE vs EE vs ME.
topics.practice: Compile and run a program from the terminal only, without the IDE's run button.

topics.title: Variables, data types, identifiers, literals, keywords
topics.description: Primitive types (byte..double, char, boolean), reference types, naming rules, literals, reserved keywords.
topics.practice: Write a program that declares one variable of every primitive type and prints its size/range.

topics.title: How Java stores negative & floating-point numbers
topics.description: Binary, two's complement for negatives, IEEE-754 floats, why 0.1 + 0.2 != 0.3, overflow.
topics.practice: Print Integer.MAX_VALUE + 1 and 0.1 + 0.2 and explain both outputs in a comment.

topics.title: Type conversion & type promotion
topics.description: Implicit widening, explicit narrowing casts, promotion in expressions (byte + byte = int), data loss.
topics.practice: Write 5 casting expressions that lose data and predict the output before running.

topics.title: Operators
topics.description: Arithmetic, relational, logical, bitwise, shift, assignment, ternary, increment/decrement, precedence.
topics.practice: Swap two numbers using XOR; check even/odd with a bitwise operator.

topics.title: Conditional statements
topics.description: if / else-if / else, nested conditions, switch (classic and arrow syntax / switch expressions).
topics.practice: Grade calculator: marks to grade using both if-else and a switch expression.

topics.title: Loops & jump statements
topics.description: for, while, do-while, for-each, break, continue, labelled break, pattern printing.
topics.practice: Print a number pyramid and find all primes below 100.

topics.title: Arrays & introduction to Strings
topics.description: Declaring/initialising arrays, default values, traversal, 2D arrays basics, String basics.
topics.practice: Reverse an array in place; count vowels in a String.

topics.title: Arrays & Strings in practice
topics.description: More array problems and String handling from the playlist's notes (link not auto-found - open the playlist at lecture 10).
topics.practice: Solve 3 easy array problems from Striver's A2Z (Arrays - easy).

topics.title: Functions deep dive, recursion, overloading
topics.description: Method signature, parameters vs arguments, return types, call stack, recursion, method overloading.
topics.practice: Write factorial and fibonacci both iteratively and recursively.

topics.title: OOP: classes, objects & the new keyword
topics.description: Why OOP, class vs object, fields and methods, what `new` does in memory.
topics.practice: Model a BankAccount class with deposit/withdraw methods.

topics.title: Constructors
topics.description: Default, parameterised and copy constructors, constructor chaining with this(), initialisation order.
topics.practice: Add three constructors to BankAccount and chain them with this().

topics.title: Objects deep dive: call by value, shallow vs deep copy
topics.description: Java is always pass-by-value (of references), aliasing, shallow vs deep copy.
topics.practice: Show with code why modifying an object inside a method is visible outside but reassigning is not.

topics.title: static & final, String[] args
topics.description: Static fields/methods/blocks, final variables/methods/classes, command-line arguments.
topics.practice: Count how many objects of a class were created using a static counter.

topics.title: Encapsulation, inheritance, packages & super
topics.description: Access modifiers, getters/setters, extends, method overriding, super, packages & imports.
topics.practice: Create Vehicle -> Car -> ElectricCar with overridden methods across packages.

topics.title: Abstraction & polymorphism, abstract class vs interface
topics.description: Compile-time vs runtime polymorphism, abstract classes, interfaces, when to use which.
topics.practice: Design a Shape hierarchy with area() and print areas through a Shape[] array.

topics.title: One public class per file, wrapper classes & autoboxing
topics.description: Why a file has one public class, wrapper types, autoboxing/unboxing, Integer cache pitfalls.
topics.practice: Explain why Integer a=127,b=127 a==b is true but 128 is false.

topics.title: Nested classes
topics.description: Static nested, inner, local and anonymous classes; when each is useful.
topics.practice: Implement a LinkedList with a private static Node class.

topics.title: Java I/O deep dive
topics.description: Streams vs readers/writers, File, BufferedReader/Writer, try-with-resources, Scanner.
topics.practice: Read a text file and write its word count to another file.

topics.title: Immutable classes
topics.description: Rules for immutability, final fields, defensive copies, why String is immutable, records.
topics.practice: Make an immutable Money class and prove it cannot be changed.

topics.title: Project: CLI Task Manager
topics.description: Build the level project end to end.
topics.practice: Add priorities, due dates and persistence to a JSON/CSV file.

topics.title: Git basics: init, add, commit, log, status

topics.practice: Make 10 small, well-named commits on your CLI project.

topics.title: Branching, merge vs rebase, merge conflicts
topics.description: Feature branches, fast-forward vs merge commits, rebasing, resolving conflicts.
topics.practice: Create a conflict on purpose between two branches and resolve it.

topics.title: GitHub: pull requests, code review, .gitignore
topics.description: Forks, PRs, review comments, protecting main.
topics.practice: Open a PR, review your own diff, then merge.

topics.title: Terminal & basic Linux commands
topics.description: cd, ls, cat, grep, find, chmod, pipes, processes, ssh.
topics.practice: Find every TODO in a project using grep and count them with wc.

topics.title: Environment variables & config outside code
topics.description: Why secrets never go into Git; .env files; 12-factor config.
topics.practice: Move a hard-coded password into an environment variable.

levels.title: Advanced Java
levels.summary: Coder Army Java Full Course, lectures 22-57: Object class, enums, String internals, generics, collections, functional programming and streams, exceptions, JVM memory and multithreading.
levels.whyItMatters: Collections, streams, exceptions and concurrency are in every service you will write and in every Java interview.
levels.projectDescription: Read a large log file, parse lines in parallel with an ExecutorService, aggregate stats with ConcurrentHashMap and print a report.

topics.title: The Object class
topics.description: equals, hashCode, toString, the equals/hashCode contract, getClass, clone.
topics.practice: Override equals/hashCode for a Student and put it in a HashSet.

topics.title: Enums
topics.description: Enum constants, fields/constructors in enums, switch on enums, values(), EnumMap basics.
topics.practice: Model OrderStatus as an enum with a method canTransitionTo().

topics.title: Interfaces in depth
topics.description: Default & static methods, multiple inheritance of type, the diamond problem, functional interfaces.
topics.practice: Solve a diamond-problem conflict between two default methods.

topics.title: String pool, immutability & internals
topics.description: String pool, new String vs literal, intern(), == vs equals, why Strings are immutable.
topics.practice: Predict the output of 6 String == comparisons, then run them.

topics.title: String methods, StringBuilder & StringBuffer
topics.description: Common String API, StringBuilder vs StringBuffer, performance of concatenation in loops.
topics.practice: Reverse words in a sentence using StringBuilder.

topics.title: Type casting of objects & introduction to Generics
topics.description: Upcasting/downcasting, instanceof (with pattern matching), why generics exist, generic classes.
topics.practice: Write a generic Box<T> and a generic method that swaps two array elements.

topics.title: Wildcards in Generics
topics.description: ? extends, ? super, PECS rule, unbounded wildcards.
topics.practice: Write sum(List<? extends Number>) and addAll(List<? super Integer>).

topics.title: Generics in depth
topics.description: Bounded types, generic methods, type erasure and its limits (notes-only lecture - open the playlist at lecture 29).
topics.practice: Try creating new T() and explain the compiler error (type erasure).

topics.title: Iterable interface
topics.description: How for-each works, Iterator, implementing Iterable for your own collection.
topics.practice: Make your LinkedList from L19 work in a for-each loop.

topics.title: Collection interface
topics.description: The Collections Framework hierarchy, Collection methods, Collections utility class.
topics.practice: Draw the hierarchy (Collection -> List/Set/Queue) from memory.

topics.title: List interface
topics.description: ArrayList vs LinkedList internals, time complexity, ListIterator, common pitfalls.
topics.practice: Benchmark add-at-front on ArrayList vs LinkedList for 100k items.

topics.title: Set & Map interfaces
topics.description: HashSet/LinkedHashSet/TreeSet, HashMap/LinkedHashMap/TreeMap, how hashing works.
topics.practice: Count word frequencies in a paragraph with a HashMap, print sorted with TreeMap.

topics.title: Set & Map methods, EnumMap, IdentityHashMap
topics.description: Map API (getOrDefault, merge, computeIfAbsent), EnumMap, IdentityHashMap, WeakHashMap.
topics.practice: Rewrite the word count using merge() in one line.

topics.title: Queue interface, PriorityQueue & heap
topics.description: Queue/Deque, ArrayDeque, PriorityQueue as a binary heap, custom ordering.
topics.practice: Find the k largest numbers in an array with a PriorityQueue.

topics.title: Comparable
topics.description: Natural ordering, compareTo contract, sorting custom objects.
topics.practice: Sort Students by marks using Comparable.

topics.title: Comparator & lambda basics
topics.description: Comparator, comparing().thenComparing(), reversed(), lambda syntax.
topics.practice: Sort Students by marks desc, then name asc, in one Comparator chain.

topics.title: Lambdas & functional interfaces
topics.description: Function, Predicate, Consumer, Supplier, method references, effectively final.
topics.practice: Replace 3 anonymous classes in your code with lambdas / method references.

topics.title: Introduction to Streams
topics.description: What a stream is, source -> intermediate -> terminal, laziness, filter/map/forEach.
topics.practice: From a list of employees, print names of those earning > 50k.

topics.title: Stream operations & collectors
topics.description: flatMap, sorted, distinct, reduce, collect, groupingBy, partitioningBy, joining.
topics.practice: Group employees by department and compute the average salary per department.

topics.title: Optional
topics.description: Why null is dangerous, Optional creation, map/orElse/orElseThrow, when not to use Optional.
topics.practice: Refactor a method returning null to return Optional.

topics.title: Parallel streams
topics.description: parallelStream, forEachOrdered, Spliterator, when parallel streams are slower.
topics.practice: Compare sequential vs parallel sum of 10M numbers and explain the result.

topics.title: Exception handling from scratch
topics.description: Checked vs unchecked, try/catch/finally, multi-catch, try-with-resources.
topics.practice: Handle NumberFormatException when parsing user input in a loop until valid.

topics.title: Exception hierarchy, throw vs throws, custom exceptions
topics.description: Throwable/Error/Exception tree, throw vs throws, creating custom exceptions, chaining.
topics.practice: Create InsufficientBalanceException for BankAccount.withdraw().

topics.title: Memory management: stack, heap, method area & PC
topics.description: JVM memory areas, what lives where, object lifecycle, StackOverflowError vs OutOfMemoryError.
topics.practice: Trigger a StackOverflowError on purpose and read the stack trace.

topics.title: Garbage collection
topics.description: How the JVM frees memory, reachability, generations (young/old), GC roots (open the playlist at lecture 46).
topics.practice: Run a program with -Xlog:gc and watch collections happen.

topics.title: Multithreading intro: process vs thread
topics.description: Concurrency vs parallelism, process vs thread, why backends are multithreaded.
topics.practice: List 3 places in a web server where threads are used.

topics.title: Thread creation & lifecycle
topics.description: Extending Thread vs Runnable, start vs run, thread states.
topics.practice: Start 3 threads that print their names and states.

topics.title: Thread methods
topics.description: sleep, join, yield, interrupt, daemon threads, priorities.
topics.practice: Use join() so main waits for 3 worker threads.

topics.title: Problems in multithreading
topics.description: Race conditions, visibility problems, deadlock, livelock, starvation.
topics.practice: Write a counter incremented by 2 threads and show the lost-update bug.

topics.title: Synchronization
topics.description: synchronized methods/blocks, intrinsic locks, volatile, happens-before.
topics.practice: Fix the lost-update counter with synchronized, then with AtomicInteger.

topics.title: Inter-thread communication
topics.description: wait/notify/notifyAll, producer-consumer problem.
topics.practice: Implement producer-consumer with a bounded buffer using wait/notify.

topics.title: Java locks
topics.description: ReentrantLock, tryLock, fairness, ReadWriteLock, Condition.
topics.practice: Rewrite producer-consumer with ReentrantLock + Condition.

topics.title: Lock-free concurrency (atomics)
topics.description: Why count++ is not atomic, AtomicInteger/AtomicLong/AtomicReference.
topics.practice: Replace a synchronized counter with AtomicLong and compare speed.

topics.title: Lock-free concurrency 2: CAS & the ABA problem
topics.description: Compare-and-swap, spin loops, ABA problem, AtomicStampedReference.
topics.practice: Explain ABA in your own words with a diagram.

topics.title: Executor framework
topics.description: Thread pools, ExecutorService, Callable/Future, fixed vs cached pools, shutdown.
topics.practice: Download 10 'URLs' (simulated with sleep) using a fixed pool of 3.

topics.title: CompletableFuture, Fork-Join, ThreadLocal, virtual threads
topics.description: Async pipelines, thenApply/thenCombine, ForkJoinPool, ThreadLocal, Java 21 virtual threads.
topics.practice: Call 3 slow services in parallel with CompletableFuture and combine the results.

topics.title: Project: multithreaded log processor
topics.description: Build the level project.
topics.practice: Measure single-thread vs multi-thread speed and explain the difference.

levels.title: Spring Boot
levels.summary: Spring Boot Full Course 2026, lectures 1-40: IoC/DI, beans, Maven, configuration, REST CRUD, Spring MVC internals, DTOs, validation, errors, filters, interceptors, AOP, JDBC, Hibernate, JPA, transactions, Security, JWT, OAuth2 and testing.
levels.whyItMatters: Most Java backend jobs are Spring Boot jobs. Understanding the request flow Controller -> Service -> Repository -> Database is the core skill.

topics.title: Spring Framework & Spring Boot introduction
topics.description: Why Spring was created, the problems of plain Java EE, what Spring Boot adds on top.
topics.practice: Write down in 5 lines: Spring vs Spring Boot.

topics.title: Your first Spring Boot app & REST API
topics.description: start.spring.io, project structure, @SpringBootApplication, a first @RestController endpoint.
topics.practice: Create a /hello endpoint and call it from the browser and from curl.

topics.title: Apache Maven
topics.description: pom.xml, dependencies, scopes, lifecycle (compile/test/package), the Maven wrapper.

topics.title: Dependency Injection & IoC
topics.description: Tight vs loose coupling, inversion of control, constructor/setter/field injection.
topics.practice: Refactor a class that does `new EmailService()` to receive it via its constructor.

topics.title: IoC container, beans, @Component, @Autowired & @Bean

topics.practice: Create one bean with @Component and one with @Bean and inject both.

topics.title: Circular dependency, bean scope, lazy & eager
topics.description: singleton vs prototype (and web scopes), @Lazy, why circular dependencies fail.
topics.practice: Create a circular dependency on purpose, read the error, fix it.

topics.title: Bean lifecycle
topics.description: Instantiation -> DI -> init -> use -> destroy, @PostConstruct, @PreDestroy, BeanPostProcessor.

topics.title: Spring XML configuration
topics.description: Configuring beans in XML (the old way) to understand what annotations replace.

topics.practice: Run with --debug and read the auto-configuration report.

topics.title: application.properties, @Value & runner interfaces
topics.description: Externalised config, @Value, @ConfigurationProperties, CommandLineRunner / ApplicationRunner.

topics.title: CRUD part 3: PATCH & soft delete

topics.practice: Draw the request flow from browser to controller and back.
